join.about: Host and guest in one session for 15 s; the guest arrives in the host's world. The guest's own max players (4) differs from the host's (2): it joins and takes the host's.

core.about: visy's s1 rows for two players: Party > Leave and Rejoin, a guest death with its bloodstain and respawn, then a party lamp travel (Tomb of Oedon) that the guest follows.
expect: guest: respawned at the host's lamp|guest: died alone: revived|revived at
the host moved to lamp 2412953|party move, lamp 2412953|map .*-> m24_01

deaths.about: Deaths outside a boss fight (no limbo there): the host dies and is revived at its lamp with its bloodstain while the guest stays in the session, then the guest dies and is revived. A wipe and the host's spectate need a boss arena (visy's s1 Gascoigne phase), which these fixtures don't reach.
expect: in-world warp \(host revive at the lamp\)
guest: respawned at the host's lamp|guest: died alone: revived|revived at

boss.about: visy's s1 boss rows for two players: party lamp travel to the Tomb of Oedon, the guest walks into Gascoigne's fog first (the intro plays for the host too), the host dies in the fight (limbo: spectates the guest), then the guest dies: one wipe, the party respawns together.
expect: travel step \d+/\d+: host_die|travel step \d+ \(host_die\) waits: the own chr is dead

three.about: A host and two guests in one session (0.7.6 guest mesh): the host counts both, each guest arrives in the host's world.

fiverejoin.about: Five players (visy CL-de2e94, not a release row: five games need about 40 GB of free commit): the host counts four guests; the fourth Leaves and Rejoins by the direct summon, not refused as a full world.

guestrest.about: visy 0.7.7 guestrest (his phase gr): the guest travels from the map to Central Yharnam's lamp, in the host's map; the host does not move, rest-load, transform or travel. Not checked: the guest's own load. With guest lamps on (the default) the travel becomes a request the host ignores (same map) and nobody loads: open in visy's tree, reported 29 Oct.
expect: asked for lamp 2412951 in this loaded map: the host does not move
forbid: host: slot \d+ rested at lamp|forced transform \(a guest's rest|a guest's rest

loadgap.about: visy 0.7.7 loadgap (his phase lg, two players): a party lamp travel to the Tomb of Oedon (the guest loads; the host stands at that lamp); the loading screens raise no 'connection unstable' notice, relay switch or outage resume. (A guest's Party > Leave, its own home load, still does: visy's, not checked here.)
expect: the host moved to lamp 2412953|party move, lamp 2412953
forbid: repeated game traffic gaps, through the host relay

openparty.about: Open party (party_open_rules.h): a passwordless host with party_open on takes a guest that joins by plain address, without the party code.
expect: open party: a player joins by plain address

openparty_off.about: Open party off (the default): the same plain-address join is refused and nobody enters the session.
expect: open party: a plain-address join refused \(this party is not open\)
